dedupe_keys.name: dados hidraulicos por reservatorio base horaria

description: ONS publishes hourly reservoir levels, useful-storage percentages and flows, including inflow, outflow, turbine flow and spill. Reservoir and generating-plant identifiers connect the measurements to hydropower facilities. These variables support reservoir-operation and hydroelectric generation models. The operator reproduces values submitted by generating agents without consistency checks; gaps and later revisions are possible. The timestamp denotes the end of an hourly interval. Publication is described as every fifteen minutes. Coverage is individual reservoirs in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
